name: Beni Kappo
description: A bold, layered theme for small counter restaurants (kappo, izakaya and omakase counters), hung like noren curtains: red panels with slit hems overlap full-bleed, lantern-lit pictures, lacquer cards edged in gold leaf sit on top, and every course is announced by a huge vermilion brush numeral; with three courses and prices, this week's course in order, a sake list, the counter seating plan, seatings, policies and a reservation request form, in sumi lacquer black, beni vermilion and shu red with warm gold-leaf highlights and off-white washi text.
